prediction_question: For a company on the live Companies House register at monthly snapshot M, will it exit the live register (be dissolved) within the following 12 months?
prediction_time: Snapshot month M (the snapshot is compiled to the end of the previous month and published within 5 working days of month end). Features would be the register row at M: company category, SIC code(s), incorporation age, registered-address region, accounts/confirmation-statement filing state, mortgage counts, previous names - all present in the measured 55-column schema.
target_definition: Binary exit: the company is absent from the live register (or carries a dissolution status) at snapshot M+12. The label source is a LATER snapshot than the feature snapshot - which is exactly the blocker recorded in rejection_reason: Companies House publishes no bulk historical snapshots and no dissolved-companies bulk product, so the label cannot be observed from anything published today.

measurements.live_only_evidence_2026_10_19: Prefix (first 4 MB, 8,109 rows, proper CSV parse): CompanyStatus Active 7,099; Liquidation 575; 'Active - Proposal to Strike off' 403; In Administration 17; other live-ish statuses 21 - and rows with DissolutionDate set: 0 of 8,109. Combined with the page text ('basic company data of live companies on the register') and the mirror row count (~5.45M unique company numbers in the 2023-11 snapshot, matching the live-register size, not the ~10M+ cumulative ever-incorporated), the bulk product is measured to be the live register only: no historical dissolution labels exist in any file publishable today.

rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), reason: the label source is unobtainable from the published bulk product. Measured 2026-10-19: the Free Company Data Product contains live-register companies only (0/8,109 prefix rows carry a DissolutionDate; the page states 'live companies on the register'; ~5.45M rows matches the live register, not the cumulative register), and Companies House publishes no bulk historical snapshots and no dissolved-companies bulk product. Three exit-label paths exist, none available today: (a) collect the monthly snapshot forward - CH publishes a fresh snapshot within 5 working days of each month end, so a scheduled monthly pull (~470 MB/month, staging-side) accumulates exit labels month by month, with a first usable 12-month exit cohort after ~12 months; (b) the Companies House API returns per-company dissolution dates but needs a free API key and is rate-limited (~600 requests/5 min), infeasible for a multi-million-company backfill; (c) third-party delta products (e.g. the commercial 'DataLedger monthly delta files' cited in ExitRadar's 2026 dissolution write-up) are not open. Additionally the register data's own licence grant was not located on the download page (see license_evidence) and must be confirmed before construction. Prior art (checked, no mirror risk): the source is mirrored raw on Kaggle (single snapshot, license Unknown, no task), ONS publishes aggregate business-demography survival rates, ExitRadar runs proprietary models on its own database, and the Productivity Insight WP61 (2025) builds a research census from register snapshots - none publishes an ML-ready exit-prediction task, so this remains a candidate once labels exist, not a rejection.
review: PARKED by operator decision 2026-10-20. The free product is the live register only, so company mortality is only observable by polling monthly snapshots (~470 MB/month, ~5.6 GB for a year) before a single label exists. Not worth the on-ramp; do not reopen without a cheaper source of dissolution dates.
next_action: None. Parked permanently unless a free historical dissolution feed appears.
